title: Section 66C, Information Technology Act, 2000 — Identity Theft
snippet: Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly make use of the electronic signature, password or any other unique identification feature of any other person, shall be punished with imprisonment.
keywords: hacked instagram facebook account password otp identity theft credential compromised social media

title: Section 66D, Information Technology Act, 2000 — Cheating by Personation
snippet: Whoever by means of any communication device or computer resource cheats by personation, shall be punished with imprisonment up to three years.
keywords: phishing fake profile impersonation online banking scam website spoofing whatsapp fraud call

title: Section 66E, Information Technology Act, 2000 — Privacy Violation
snippet: Whoever intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes or transmits the image of a private area of any person without consent violates privacy.
keywords: privacy leaked photos private videos recorded without consent photos blackmail camera morphed

title: Section 65B, Indian Evidence Act, 1872 — Electronic Records Admissibility
snippet: Any information contained in an electronic record is deemed a document and admissible in evidence subject to conditions and certificate under Section 65B(4).
keywords: electronic record digital evidence chat logs email screenshot server log certificate

title: Section 503 & 506, Indian Penal Code — Criminal Intimidation
snippet: Whoever threatens another with any injury to his person, reputation or property with intent to cause alarm, commits criminal intimidation.
keywords: threat death threat threatened kill harm intimidation verbal abuse violent warning doorstep

title: Section 323 & 351, Indian Penal Code — Assault & Causing Hurt

title: Section 378 & 379, Indian Penal Code — Theft & Stolen Property
snippet: Whoever intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without consent commits theft.
